text: In this town, everybody goes out partying except me. Hush, hush, hush. Hush, hush, hush. [gentle music] You see, every single night there's a party somewhere. Pool parties, pizza parties, even a birthday party for the mayor's goldfish. Nobody here practices anything. Why would they? There's always another party going on. My best friend Kevin goes to every party. My neighbor Linda goes to every party. Even my grandma goes dancing on Tuesdays, but not me. Hush, hush, hush. Hush, hush, hush. [blows] Day by day. Hush, hush, hush. Hush, hush, hush. Then came the biggest party of the year, the summer party basketball game. Everybody showed up in party hats. When I walked onto the court, everybody laughed. "Who's the kid in the beanie?" Then I got the ball. Hush, hush, hush. Hush, hush, hush. [blows] Fifty points all by myself. The music stopped. The whole crowd went silent. Kevin walked up to me and asked, "When did you get so good?" I told him the truth, "While you were out partying." The next night, I walked through town and something was wrong. No music, no party lights, nothing. Then I heard it from every single window. Hush, hush, hush. Hush, hush, hush. Kevin was practicing the guitar. Linda was practicing karate. My grandma was doing push-ups. Nobody goes to parties anymore. The whole town is grinding, which is great. Except now I'm the only one who's free on a Friday night, so I threw a party. The only guest was the mayor's goldfish. He's actually a pretty good dancer. Hush, hush, hush. [gentle music]
